ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a white-to-black pixel ratio of approximately 8.5:1 across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous zones covering approx. 80% of surface area; low-intensity (black) boundaries along trailing edges and distal tips; vertical low-intensity column at central base; isolated low-intensity circular clusters in mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped depression with an approximate aperture of 70 degrees and a pixel-depth of ~15% relative to the vertical fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth pattern; pixel-amplitude variations between 2 and 12 pixels relative to the local edge mean; higher density of peaks toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve with a positive second derivative relative to the horizontal axis, terminating in slightly hooked, low-intensity distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete low-intensity circular pixel clusters detected: four in the lower-left quadrant and five in the mid-to-lower right quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single visible linear disruption (approx. 40 pixels in length) at an oblique angle in the lower-right quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large irregular dark marking at the central peduncle transition; non-uniform trailing edge indentations suggestive of previous mechanical impact.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'feathered' transition zone between dark trailing edge and white ventral field on the right lobe inner margin.
